Open and inspect every screenshot you describe. Put the best inspected gameplay screenshot first in `screenshots`; put menus, title cards, concept art, promotional banners, blank frames, and editor captures later. Score the graphics quality of visible gameplay screenshots from 0 to 100 for visual polish, composition, and scene detail. Reward coherent stylized art as well as realism. Explain the screenshot score relative to relevant catalog games without inferring motion or gameplay feel from still images.

Treat that object as a schema example, not a finding. Use categories such as `engine`, `language`, `framework`, `rendering`, `physics`, `audio`, or `build`. Use an empty array when no technology is established. Do not infer an engine or version from appearance alone.

# Plantas vs IA

[](#plantas-vs-ia)

**Jugar en el navegador:** [https://yefry08.github.io/plantas-vs-ia/](https://yefry08.github.io/plantas-vs-ia/)

Tower defense por carriles hecho en **Godot 4 (GDScript)**, jugable en el navegador. Las plantas defienden el jardín de oleadas de **robots IA** (todos son parodias originales, sin logos ni marcas). Una **IA aliada** te ayuda a cambio de **tokens** (moneda simbólica del juego).

-   5 carriles × 9 columnas, energía solar, dron de emergencia por carril, pala, pausa y velocidad ×2.
-   15 plantas, 22 robots, 6 cartas de IA aliada y 4 compañeros de IA para elegir.
-   Campaña de 24 niveles en 5 zonas + el jefe final **La AGI** (3 fases, 2 finales).
-   Robots parodia de las grandes IA: DeepFish, Qwin, TalkGPT, Grow, los Claudios, Fairytail, Legend, Musa, Dotz, langostas y cangrejos OpenGarra...
-   Zona final **Bio-Laboratorio**: bioarmas IA que toman el control de tus plantas.
-   Arte 100 % procedural (formas vectoriales, caras tipo emoji dibujadas), música original compuesta por código (`tools/generate_music.gd`) y efectos suaves sintetizados: **cero assets de terceros**.
-   Todo el contenido es data-driven en archivos `.tres`.
-   Progreso guardado en `user://` (en web se guarda en IndexedDB del navegador).

- 15 plantas, 22 robots, 6 cartas de IA aliada y 4 compañeros de IA para elegir.

| Recoger energía / tokens | Toca el sol que cae | |

| Pausa / velocidad ×2 | Botones `II` y `x1` | `Esc`/`P`, `F` |

| Alineamiento | 8 | El robot se vuelve aliado 15 s |

## Play

- Open https://hamilton-junior.github.io/osrs-tower-defense/ in a browser; nothing to install and no account needed.
- Pick a mode (Classic or Roguelite) and a difficulty tier starting at Normal; winning unlocks the next tier up to Grandmaster.
- Build towers beside the procedurally cut road on the 45x20 board; upgrade them through OSRS-gear tier ladders and fuse matching finished pairs into six forge weapons.
- Kill a boss every tenth wave; after each boss pick one of seven regions to march to next, keeping towers, terrain and carved bends.
- Survive to wave 130 to win the run; Endless mode keeps counting after that, and the daily challenge offers the same map and boss order per UTC day.

## Mechanics

- Fixed 45x20 board at 1440x640 with a different procedurally cut road every run; monsters march it end to end and each leak costs one of 20 lives
- 130-wave run structure with a boss every tenth wave, win at wave 130, Endless beyond; seven unlockable regions change palette, native monsters and diary tasks while towers and terrain persist
- Two modes: Classic (pure TD) and Roguelite (reward cards bought with gold between waves plus rule-rewriting relics from bosses)
- Seven Combat-Achievement-tier difficulties from Normal to Grandmaster (up to 2.8x enemy HP, 30% less gold, five lives); wins unlock the next tier
- Twelve towers: six base (Archer, Wizard, Cannon, TzHaar, Slayer, Toxic) with OSRS-gear tier ladders plus six fused weapons from adjacent finished pairs
- 61 monsters and 14 bosses with bespoke mechanics (Zulrah form rotation, Jad healer drain, Corporeal Beast tower siphon) plus volatile/warded monster affixes
- Wizard spellbooks: single-target Elemental, crowd Ancients barrage, or Utility curses and sanctity
- OSRS skills in TD roles: Slayer tasks, Prayer damage/protection burn, Herblore wave-length potions, plus Farming, Fishing and Hunter without timing or APM demands
- Metagame: Collection Log, rotatable-model Bestiary, Combat Achievements, per-region Diaries, boss pets, permanent Essence Shop upgrades, daily seeded challenge with best-score board, browser-local saves plus transferable save codes

- Two modes (Classic pure TD; Roguelite with gold-bought reward cards and boss-paid rule-rewriting relics) and seven Combat-Achievement difficulties up to Grandmaster (2.8x HP, 30% less gold, five lives). ([source](https://github.com/hamilton-junior/osrs-tower-defense/blob/main/README.md))
